run_test_offline: run an offline RL training pipeline that fills a replay buffer, trains with PyTorch Lightning, and evaluates against a passing score bar
evaluate_cem: evaluate a CEM policy over N episodes by creating an agent and running evaluate_for_n_episodes
identity_collate: create a DataLoader collate function that returns the single item from a batch list
test_gym_offline_cpu: run parameterized offline Gym tests on CPU using CEM Cartpole and world model linear dynamics configs
test_gym_offline_gpu: run parameterized offline Gym tests on GPU using CEM Cartpole and world model linear dynamics configs
